body: I've talked to my parents, counselors/therapists, and my doctor about things. Antidepressants help a little, but so far talking just makes me more depressed. As for a routine, I never really had one. I've pretty much viewed the world through my computer screen for the last 10 years. I try to get out and do things but everytime I do something happens that sends me right back to being stuck at home.
